# Color Palette Generator

Generate harmonious color palettes for UI design.

## Color Schemes
- Complementary: opposite on color wheel
- Analogous: adjacent colors
- Triadic: three evenly spaced
- Monochromatic: single hue variations

## Output Format
Provide colors in HEX, RGB, and HSL formats.

## Accessibility
- Ensure WCAG 2.1 AA contrast ratios (4.5:1 for text)
- Test with color blindness simulators
- Avoid relying solely on color for meaning
